{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMidAutumnMessageOpen.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 3: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMidAutumnMessageLoop3.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Noan', 3: 'Bzzzt... Commandant ▇▃█▂... can you hear ▂▇▅▃ me...', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBeginHei.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'BZZZZT—BZZZZT—'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}

{3: "Noan's voice cuts in and out over the comms as you lose the signal again. After a few minutes of silence, the connection finally crackles back to life, likely through some effort on Noan's end."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 3: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Noan', 3: '...That should do it. Commandant, can you hear me?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'I can hear you.', 3: '23', 4: 'Are you alright over there, Noan?', 5: '23'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: "Good to hear your voice. I'm alright. I've managed to reach the signal amplifier, so we should be able to talk without issue for now. However...", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Noan', 3: "My instruments show our positions clearly, and we're indeed drifting further away from each other. It seems the isolation tests we've run haven't given us anything consistent to work with.", 4: '1'}
{2: "I'm sorry it didn't work this time either.", 3: '27'}
{2: "Even after I promised I'd help make your wish come true.", 3: '28'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: "Don't apologize, Commandant. If anything, it just means I haven't tried hard enough.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'You both go quiet. Only the occasional burst of static keeps the call from being completely silent.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMidAutumnMessageLoop3.prefab'}

{3: 'This event was organized by a member of the WGAA. Drawing inspiration from the abandoned trains of the Golden Age, he recreated their carriages as a series of curated scenes from different cultures.'}

{3: 'The plan drew little enthusiasm, however, and few showed any interest or signed up for the preview tests. When he gave out flyers at the square three days ago, Noan was the only one who reached out and took one.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 3: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMidAutumnMessageLoop3.prefab', 2: '2'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Noan', 3: "The rules are that we'd set off separately in this maze-like train, and we'd have to make the same choice independently at each isolation test. Only then do our paths align and bring us to the same carriage.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: 'Well... looks like the good ending is off the table for this round. If someone turned this into a game, I have a feeling that the difficulty alone would tank its reviews.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: "Given that we keep getting the bad ending, why don't we save and restart? I can reach out to the organizer to put this run on hold, and we can start fresh from the top.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Noan', 3: 'How about we swap routes in the next round? I\'ll take the "Decay" path, and you can take the "Revival" one. At the very least, you\'d get to see better scenery and make the trip worth your while.', 4: '1'}
{2: "I don't want to give up yet.", 3: '49', 4: 'I want to keep trying.', 5: '49'}
{3: 'Turning over your reply in his mind, Noan has his suspicions about your reason, but it is one he does not quite dare believe.'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: "...Can I venture a guess that it's the same answer as before?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: '"Because it is your wish."', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Because it is your wish.', 3: '57'}
{3: 'You speak at the same time, the same words converging over the comms. It reminds Noan of the last time he heard that phrase.'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: 'I remember the organizer telling me that the test had to be done in pairs, so I needed to find a partner, and you were the only person who came to mind.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: 'I had a whole speech ready to win you over, but you said yes the moment I finished asking without hesitation.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: 'I even asked if you wanted to know more, like why I needed the help in the first place. But all you said was, "Because it is your wish."', 4: '1'}
{2: 'It was clear how much this meant to you.', 3: '62'}
{2: "You've been trying hard to win the last few attempts.", 3: '63'}
{2: "But you're welcome to share your reasons with me.", 3: '64'}
{3: 'The sound on the other end of the comms cuts out. Noan has been charting the map and coming up with more optimized routes, but your words give him pause.'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: "The truth is, I couldn't tell you exactly why myself, Commandant. I was just taking a walk through the square when I saw the organizer pitch his idea to anyone who'd listen.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: "Sweating and worn down, he'd clearly been at it for hours. But he kept going even when people brushed him off, and he was just as earnest as ever.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Noan', 3: "When I took the flyer from him, he told me that even if most people didn't believe in his idea with the abandoned trains, he'd still see it through regardless. That was what he wanted to express—", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: '"Because at its heart, civilization is nothing more than a dead tree learning to bloom again."', 4: '1'}
{2: 'You understood him.', 3: '72', 4: 'You agreed with him.', 5: '72'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: "Perhaps, but it was like deja vu. I saw glimpses of things I'd seen in others, and some I recognized from my own life.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Noan', 3: "Compared to all the bright, colorful ideas, the abandoned trains spoke to me more. Fighting through impossible odds and finding life in something forgotten... How do you know there isn't a path unless you walk it?", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Noan', 3: 'So I find myself hoping it succeeds and proves something to the doubters. But on a more personal note... I wanted you to be here to see it, Commandant. Call it a small indulgence of mine.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: "Though I'll admit, it's been far more difficult than I anticipated. This is already our fifth test, and yet...", 4: '1'}

{3: 'The test is being recorded for official reports and promotional use, but if you two fail to meet, it undermines the core concept that civilizations can converge. Without that, others will not be convinced or drawn in.'}

{2: 'Noan', 3: "I've gone over every possible route. At this stage, you'll always arrive at the same final carriage, no matter what you choose, so don't overthink it. Just go with whatever feels right.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'What about you?', 3: '81'}

{2: 'Noan', 3: 'There are more options and quite a few possible endpoints on my end, but thanks to my earlier miscalculation, every path goes in the exact opposite direction from you if I continue.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Noan', 3: "It seems like there's no way for us to meet at the same endpoint this time around. Perhaps the best we can do is push through quickly and meet up outside the carriages? We can give it another go if you want.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: "Then again... there is one other possibility I worked out, but it's a long shot.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'What do you need me to do?', 3: '85'}

{2: 'Noan', 3: "In theory, I'm the only one who needs to do anything. But after what you said earlier... I find myself getting a little greedy. There's one thing I want to hear from you first.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: 'So answer me this one question: Do you want to see me, Commandant?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: 'Alright. I see.', 4: '1'}
{3: "A faint crackle comes through the comms, then the telltale static of a fading signal. Beneath it, Noan's voice cuts in and out."}
{2: 'Noan', 3: "Commandant, I don't have much time, so listen carefully. Continue forward, and choose whatever path feels right to you. Just keep walking until you reach the last carriage.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBeginHei.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: 'The signal loss is just... ▇▄ temporary. Trust ▆▂▄▅... me, ▆█▂▄ Commandant.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBeginHei.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: "Keep ▇▂▅▄ going... leave ▇█▄▅▃ everything to me. I'll ▇▃▆▅ be... waiting for you.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Beep—beep—'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMidAutumnMessageEnd.prefab', 2: '2'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMidAutumnMessageLoop3.prefab'}

{3: 'As Noan moves away from the device, the connection is severed, and the comms is filled with nothing but static. With nothing else to go on, all you can do is take his words to heart and continue down the path of "Decay".'}

{3: 'The "Decay" and "Revival" routes selected in a two-player run are a deliberate design choice. Each paints a different portrait of civilization, but if the players\' choices align, the paths converge into a shared ending.'}
{3: 'The scenery along the route is nothing to write home about, but it is a unique way to experience different cultures.'}
{3: 'The route unfolds exactly as Noan described. The path is quite straightforward, and the final carriage is within reach before long.', 17: '1'}
{3: 'Right then, your comms rings, and you hear a fragmented but unmistakable voice.', 22: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMidAutumnMessageOpen.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 3: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMidAutumnMessageLoop3.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Noan', 3: 'Commandant... Do you... ▆▄▂ copy... Are you... ▆▇ alright ▄▂▅█ over there?', 4: '1'}
{2: "Noan? I'm fine. The signal's coming back.", 3: '126'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBeginHei.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: 'Good ▇▃█▅▅... are you close ▇▄▂ to the final carriage?', 4: '1'}
{2: "I'm almost there.", 3: '130'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: "That's good. Then we'll be able to ▇▄▂▆.", 4: '1'}
{2: "We'll be able to what? I didn't catch that.", 3: '132'}
{2: "What's going on? Have you already come out the other exit?", 3: '133'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: '—No. No, Commandant.', 4: '1'}

{3: "When you lay your hand on the door to the final carriage, the static is completely gone. Only Noan's clear and gentle voice remains, as though it has passed through every iron wall to reach your side."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiBegin.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMidAutumnMessageLoop3.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront52.png', 4: '4'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg6001_08.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiEnd.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiBegin.prefab'}
{3: '—Creak. The door opens, and you are greeted by a decorated carriage...'}
{1: '1', 3: '...And Noan himself, who raises his camera with a smile. With you two being in the same room, his voice from the comms and his actual voice become one.', 22: '1'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: "I'm right here. No more waiting. No more making your way to somewhere far off.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: 'You just needed to reach the end, and I took care of the rest and came all the way to where you are. That was how we could meet as fast as possible.', 4: '1'}

{3: 'Noan steps forward and takes your hand, leading you to a window. Up close, you can see carefully chosen decorations tucked into every corner of the original interior of the carriage, making the space feel new.'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: 'I brought everything I could carry. I wanted to put together a decent scene for you to take in.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Noan', 3: 'I ran the numbers, and there was only enough time for one of us to change course, and barely at that. So I turned around and went as fast as I could, took the other route, and got to your carriage ahead of you.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'So this is the "miracle" that actually comes true.', 3: '160'}
{2: 'Was it my answer that made the difference?', 3: '161'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: "Always. It's always been you from the very beginning.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Noan', 3: "I had my doubts. Would this one fail too? Would putting you through these tests again and again wear on you? None of that would have mattered if it were only me, but you're different.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: 'So when you said you cared about my wish, and that you would give me your trust and company... That was what gave me the courage to try.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: 'Commandant, may I keep coming to you for your answer in the future during moments like this?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Every time. My answer will always be yes.', 3: '168', 4: 'Next time, I can be the one who comes to you.', 5: '168'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: "That's good enough for me, Commandant.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Noan', 3: "The moment you said you wanted to see me, that alone made it all worth it. With that courage, I refused to let us miss each other just because the odds were against it. I'd go against the current to find my way to you.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'His words continue, his gaze drifting toward you. Sunlight spills through the window, filling the carriage at last, and the one he has been waiting for is finally with him.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryQujingkuang.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: "The light's perfect right now. Let's take a photo together to remember this by, Commandant.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Noan', 3: 'Whatever scenery we see together, I want to freeze each one at its most beautiful moment like now. It will be something significant, something that belongs to both of us.', 4: '1'}
